bootstrap.method: Unchanged paired crossed query/draw bootstrap, with training-block resampling for equal-weight all3-arm summaries and transfer contrasts only.
bootstrap.K0: One actual measured query/model observation, broadcast unchanged across shared draw resamples; no independent query inflation.
bootstrap.shared_base: One untreated record reused by identity across block contrasts; never a new independent baseline replicate.
bootstrap.intervals: Pointwise descriptive intervals; few draw/training clusters can yield unreliable coverage; no multiplicity-adjusted, power, equivalence or noninferiority claim.

limits: All strict invalid outputs count as errors; no rows or models selected by efficacy.
